title: Manna
summary: Manna was God’s wilderness provision and taught Israel daily dependence on His word and care.
background: Manna came with instructions about gathering, Sabbath, and trust. Later Scripture uses manna to point to God’s provision and Christ as the true bread from heaven.
teachingHelp: Emphasize daily dependence, obedience, and God’s faithful provision before drawing Christ-centered connections in John 6.
